notes: The will is reported as Musa b. Ja'far's own writing, so the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2); «عدة من أهل بيته» is an unnamed gap
Doubt (rule 11): after the will a second narrated scene follows, «قالَ عَبْدِ اللَّه بْنِ مُحَمَّد الجَعْفَرِيُّ: قالَ العَبَّاسُ بْنِ مُوسَى», with its own speaker; it is not added as a link
Witnesses named in the will («وَإِسْحاقَ بْنَ جَعْفَرِ», «الْعَبَّاسَ») are in the content, not the chain
